left_rabbeting_top.comment:
116) Derived - Model
    Distance from the top edge of the stile to the beginning of rabbeting on the left side of the stile. if the distance between the door and the top of the still is <2"" then the rabbeting starts at the beginning of the stile with no radius cut in.

left_rabbeting_bottom.expression: if(LD_floor_clearance < through_rabbeting_threshold; -2 in; component_net_height - ( LD_stile_hole_modifier + LD_height + rabbeting_stop_below_door ))
left_rabbeting_bottom.comment:
117) Derived - Model
    Distance from the top edge of the stile to the end of rabbeting on the left side of the stile. if the door_floor_clearance equals 1" or 4.5", then the rabbeting goes all the way to the end of the stile with no radius cut in.
